content:
<@792404665068158998> Right now your modification expects INVALID_BLOCK_ACCESS_LIST (status: INVALID), but if you decode these fields as real RLP scalars, a leading zero fails at parse time. on Besu that’s -32602, same as any other bad blockAccessList encoding.

Feels more like malformed params than a BAL content/hash mismatch. Why not engine_api_error_code=EngineAPIError.InvalidParams here?
